Scripts.Name: Full System Forensic Snapshot (All Modules)
Scripts.Description: Executes all read-only diagnostic, correlation, integrity, network, event, and Obsidian sync scripts and refreshes dashboard data.

Scripts.Name: System Stability, GPU TDR & Shell Crash Investigation
Scripts.Description: Collects GPU TDR LiveKernelEvents (P1: 141 / Event 4101), Application Error 1000, Application Hang 1002, WER reports, crash dumps, and shell extensions.

Scripts.Name: Hardware, Firmware & Platform Security Inventory
Scripts.Description: Collects CPU, DIMMs, GPUs/VRAM, Motherboard/BIOS, SMART Disks, Volumes, Network Adapters, Monitors, Peripherals, Hotfixes, and TPM/SecureBoot/VBS.

Scripts.Name: Real-Time Performance & GPU/RAM/IO Telemetry
Scripts.Description: Captures system-wide and per-process CPU, Working Set, Private Bytes, Commit Size, GPU Engine/VRAM, Disk Latency, Network Throughput, Handles, and Threads.

Scripts.Name: Fast Live CPU, RAM, GPU & VRAM Telemetry Streamer
Scripts.Description: Zero-dependency WMI/CIM live hardware telemetry sampler updating CPU load %, RAM used GB, GPU 3D/Copy engine utilization %, and Dedicated/Shared VRAM used MB with single-instance PID lockfile, atomic file writes, and explicit handle disposal.

Scripts.Name: Process Inventory, Hashes & Authenticode Verification
Scripts.Description: Enumerates all active processes with PID, PPID, Creation Time, Command Line, SHA-256 hash, Authenticode signature, and parent-child validation.

Scripts.Name: Windows Services & Host Process Cross-Reference
Scripts.Description: Enumerates all Windows services, start modes, ServiceDll parameters, and hosting PIDs.

Scripts.Name: Kernel & Display Driver Inventory
Scripts.Description: Audits loaded kernel and file-system drivers, verifying signatures on third-party or non-standard path drivers.

Scripts.Name: Registry Autorun, Winlogon & IFEO Persistence Audit
Scripts.Description: Audits HKLM/HKCU Run, RunOnce, Policies, Winlogon Shell/Userinit, Startup folders, and Image File Execution Options.

Scripts.Name: Network Connections, Listening Ports & IP Intelligence
Scripts.Description: Collects active TCP/UDP sockets, owning PIDs, services, firewall status, connection durations, and public IP WHOIS/ASN/Country enrichment.

Scripts.Name: External Public IP WHOIS/RDAP & DNS Enrichment
Scripts.Description: Performs RDAP/WHOIS, ASN, Organization, Country, and Reverse DNS PTR lookup for public remote IP addresses.

Scripts.Name: Multi-Channel Windows Event Log Forensics
Scripts.Description: Collects and clusters events from System, Application, Setup, Defender, PowerShell Operational, RestartManager, Sysmon, and Security logs.

Scripts.Name: Unified Entity Correlation Engine
Scripts.Description: Correlates Processes, PPIDs, SHA-256 Hashes, Authenticode Signatures, Windows Services, Registry Keys, and Network Endpoints with Threat & Risk scoring.

Scripts.Name: System Binary Integrity & Microsoft Signature Validation
Scripts.Description: Verifies SHA-256 hashes, Microsoft Authenticode & Catalog signatures, OS binary flags, and local baseline matches across System32 and active processes.

Scripts.Name: Create/Refresh Trusted System Binary Baseline
Scripts.Description: Snapshots SHA-256 hashes and version metadata of core Windows binaries into Data\Baselines and Evidence\HashManifests.

Scripts.Name: VirusTotal & Multi-Engine Hash / Binary / DLL Lookup
Scripts.Description: Computes SHA-256/SHA-1/MD5, PE metadata, and Authenticode signature for any .exe, .dll, .sys, or service path and queries VirusTotal v3 API / generates direct VirusTotal & Hybrid-Analysis lookup links.

Scripts.Name: Malware, Persistence, WMI & Rootkit Heuristics Audit
Scripts.Description: Scans for process masquerading, suspicious paths, WMI permanent subscriptions, IFEO hooks, scheduled tasks, wildcard listeners, and driver anomalies.

Scripts.Name: Deep Scheduled Tasks, BITS Jobs & PowerShell 4104 ScriptBlock Audit
Scripts.Description: Audits Scheduled Tasks (with binary SHA-256 & Authenticode verification), BITS transfer queues, and PowerShell Event ID 4104 ScriptBlock transcripts for encoded/obfuscated execution.

Scripts.Name: Full System Crash, BugCheck Root-Cause & Memory Dump Forensics
Scripts.Description: Decodes Kernel-Power Event 41 BugCheck Stop Codes and 64-bit Parameters 1-4, volmgr Event 161, WHEA hardware errors, 30-minute Pre-Crash Activity correlation, and inventories MEMORY.DMP, Minidumps, LiveKernelReports (WATCHDOG TDR), and User CrashDumps.

Scripts.Name: Capture On-Demand Process MiniDump
Scripts.Description: Captures a diagnostic user-mode minidump for a specified TargetPID into Evidence\MemoryDumps with chain-of-custody SHA-256 logging.

Scripts.Name: Synchronize Findings to Obsidian Vault
Scripts.Description: Generates cross-linked Obsidian Markdown records for investigations, system baselines, and threat findings.

Scripts.Name: Export Forensic Tables to CSV Suites
Scripts.Description: Exports all forensic datasets (Processes, Network, Integrity, Security Findings, Crash Dumps) to timestamped CSV files in Reports\CSV.

Scripts.Name: Generate Browser GPU/DOM Diagnostic Monitor Snippet
Scripts.Description: Generates a read-only browser JS diagnostic observer to track WebGL context loss, DOM blanking, and WebSocket drops on any web application.

Scripts.Name: Generate Unified Forensic Super-Timeline (JSON + CSV)
Scripts.Description: Merges Process Creation, Network Socket Creation, Windows Event Logs, System Crash BugChecks, Crash Dumps (by ModifiedUtc), Scheduled Tasks, and PowerShell 4104 ScriptBlocks into a single timestamp-sorted chronological Super-Timeline.

Scripts.Name: Compile Single-File Portable Executive HTML Report
Scripts.Description: Bundles HTML, Light/Dark CSS, JavaScript, and the complete forensic snapshot into a single self-contained .html file in Reports\Executive with a SHA-256 integrity hash.

Scripts.Name: Authorized System Remediation Runner (Preview / Execute)
Scripts.Description: Previews or executes explicitly authorized remediation actions (Explorer SeparateProcess, GPU TdrDelay, Service Timeout, RustDesk Manual).
